E1.evidence: The issue gives a step-by-step reproducer (clone shonigmann/ros2_control_demos branch controller_manager_rename, launch rrbot.launch.py) with the observed `ros2 node list` output, and a second user states "I was able to reproduce this error" (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/785#issuecomment-1195770282).

units_identified: forward_command_controller (controller plugin loaded by controller_manager; joint_state_broadcaster likewise)
E2.evidence: The trigger is the launch-file node name (`name="renamed_controller_manager"` on the ros2_control_node launch action), which passes a process-global node-name remap that rclcpp applies to every node created in the process (root cause named by the reporter: https://github.com/ros2/rclcpp/issues/843, "the `__node:=some_node_name` argument applies to all nodes in that process"). The resolution that the reporter confirmed ("this does solve the issue on my end as well, cheers!", https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/785#issuecomment-1195980814) replaces the launch `name=` with a node-targeted remap in the same launch file: `("controller_manager:__name", "renamed_controller_manager")` (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/785#issuecomment-1195770282). The minimal resolving change therefore only rebinds a node name at deployment (a launch remap); no declared or referenced interface of controller_manager or of the controllers changed, and no code change was made for this issue.

E3.evidence: PAIR: controller_manager creates/loads the controller nodes in its own process and the controller reads its parameters under the node name it receives; the reporter observes "The `ForwardPositionController` fails to start because the `joints` parameter is undefined (because it looks for the parameter in the scope of the `renamed_controller_manager` rather than `forward_position_controller`)." Both units are also active in the same process at the same time (CONCURRENT), which is how the global remap reaches the controller.

E4.evidence: Observed effect: "The controller_manager and controllers are all named `renamed_controller_manager`" with the `ros2 node list` warning "WARNING: Be aware that are nodes in the graph that share an exact name, this can have unintended side effects." and the forward position controller failing to start (https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2_control/issues/785).

ineligible_reason: deployment_wiring: the documented resolution is a launch-file remap (`controller_manager:__name` targeted node-name remap instead of the launch `name=` argument); no unit's declared or referenced interface changed.
